facts.text: Wukong mocks Macaque and MK while they are praying.
Macaque is annoyed by Wukong but tries to ignore him and continue praying.
Wukong says the Jade Emperor is scared of Wukong.
MK watches Macaque experiment with his powers.
Some of Macaque's powers are gradually coming back.
MK has hope while watching Macaque's powers return.
MK watches Macaque experiment with his powers again.
Some of Macaque's powers are gradually coming back again.
MK has hope again while watching Macaque's powers return.
Wukong comes to drag MK out of a cage for "play".
Macaque intervenes when Wukong tries to drag MK out of the cage.
MK is surprised by the amount of magic Macaque has now.
Macaque's magic is still not enough to stop Wukong.
Wukong drags MK off despite Macaque intervening.
Wukong comes to drag MK out of a cage for "play" again.
Macaque intervenes when Wukong tries to drag MK out of the cage again.
MK is surprised by the amount of magic Macaque has now again.
Macaque's magic is still not enough to stop Wukong again.
Wukong drags MK off again despite Macaque intervening.
